name: Tuna and Sweetcorn Jacket Potato
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potato all over with a fork and bake for 60 minutes until the skin is crisp and the inside soft.
Drain the tuna and sweetcorn and mix with the mayonnaise, a pinch of pepper and a little salt.
Split the hot potato, spoon the tuna and sweetcorn mayonnaise into the middle and serve.
